predecessors.name: Abbasid Caliphate
predecessors.text: the Cilician (Syrian) Thughur, 'Tarsus and the rest of Cilicia'

successors.name: Byzantine Empire
successors.text: 'The Byzantine emperor Nikephoros II Phokas captured the city and the rest of Cilicia, ending Muslim rule there' (16 August 965)

ledger.x: 787/8: the Cilician frontier zone is drawn.
August 965: the conquest of Cilicia ends with Tarsus.
16 August 965: the Emirate of Tarsus ends.

wars.name: Byzantine conquest of Cilicia
wars.outcome: Nikephoros II Phokas captured Cilicia in 964-965, Tarsus on 16 August 965, and Antioch soon after; the Hamdanids of Aleppo, who had been Tarsus's overlord since 946/7, became tributary to Byzantium.

certainty.note: A frontier march, with the Amanus separating it from the Jazira Thughur; no page gives its limits.
